random.description: This is a gross autopsy photograph of the cranial cavity, focusing on the internal surface of the skull base. The image shows the bone of the cranial fossa with areas of hemorrhage and a visible ruler for measurement. These findings are consistent with cranial trauma, such as a skull fracture associated with intracranial hemorrhage. The view provides a forensic or neuropathological examination of the skull bones after scalp reflection.
